acc.title: Profile · Business info
acc.sub: Edit your member and business information.
acc.loadFail: Could not load your member information. Please refresh in a moment.
acc.locked: Some items cannot be edited. Email is your login method, so it is changed through a separate process. Changing the business registration number means becoming a different business, so you need to register again instead of editing.
acc.verifiedNote: Identity verified. If you change your name, you need to verify again.
acc.verifiedWhy: It would differ from the verified name.
acc.unverifiedWhy: Required to make inquiries and join deals.
acc.pwNote: Changing your password logs you out on all other devices. If you enter your current password incorrectly 5 times, your account will be locked for 30 minutes.
acc.noBizText: Creating deals · offering referral fees · issuing contracts require only identity verification. Register business info when you want to receive referral fees as a business (tax invoice).
acc.bizEditable: You can edit it because it is not verified yet. After editing, apply for business verification.
acc.bizLocked: Verified business information cannot be edited. If it differs from what the National Tax Service confirmed, that confirmation would no longer be valid.
acc.bizLockedTail: If anything has changed, verify again.
acc.withdrawB: If you want to stop using SogaeBank
acc.withdrawText: You can delete your account only when there are no ongoing deals · settlements · orders. The deletion page checks this first.

withdraw.loadFail: Could not load account deletion info. Please refresh in a moment.
withdraw.blockedB: You can delete your account after the items below are finished.
withdraw.blockedText: Terms of Service Art. 13 ② — if deals or settlements are in progress, deletion is processed after they finish.
withdraw.errOther: If you chose “Other”, please write the reason.
withdraw.errPw: Please enter your current password to confirm it is you.
withdraw.errAgree: Please read the notice and tick the checkbox.
withdraw.memoPh: We will use this to improve. Please do not include personal info such as name · contact.
withdraw.agree: I have read the notice above and understand that deletion cannot be undone.

refund.noteChecking: The payment provider is checking the result. You do not need to pay again or take any other action — it will be reflected once confirmed.
refund.noteFailed: The payment provider did not accept the cancellation. Your subscription and payment remain unchanged — please apply again or contact customer support.
refund.noteDone: The payment provider has confirmed the cancellation. Depending on your card issuer, it will be reflected within 3–5 business days.
refund.noteStub: Integration is not live yet (stub), so this is not a real refund.

notice.PLAN_CHANGE: From your next billing date ({date}), your plan changes to {plan} ({price}/month) — withdraw the scheduled change to stay on your current plan.
notice.NO_METHOD: Auto-renewal is scheduled, but no payment method is registered. Renewal will fail unless you add one.
notice.PAST_DUE: The recurring payment failed. Please check your payment method — the subscription expires if payment is not made within the grace period.
notice.CANCEL_RESERVED: Cancellation scheduled. You can use it until {date}, and you will not be charged after that.
notice.CANCELLED_UNPAID: Canceled. You will not be charged again. Paid features are unavailable because this period was not paid.
notice.CHARGE_IN_FLIGHT: The payment provider is confirming the recurring payment. It will be reflected once confirmed — please do not pay again.
notice.REFUND_OPEN: We are checking the refund result. Use and renewal of this subscription are paused until the result is in.

sub.title: Subscription · Referral codes
sub.sub: SogaeBank earns from two sources — the monthly subscription and extra referral code fees. There is no fee tied to the deal amount.
sub.payFail: Payment was not completed. You were not charged — please try again.
sub.extraNote: Extra referral codes are a flat {price} each. The fee is the same regardless of the deal amount — it is not taken out of the referral fee (B-13R · INV-9). Referral fees are agreed and paid directly between the parties; SogaeBank does not hold, pay out, or deduct them.
sub.personal: Individual members can subscribe too. To receive referral fees as a business (tax invoice),
sub.codesN: {n, plural, one {{n} referral code} other {{n} referral codes}}/mo
sub.basicNote: If you need a referral code, it is issued at a flat {price} each.
sub.paidNote: If you cancel, your listing slots decrease and some listings will be taken down.
sub.refundNote: Refunds are available only on the day of payment. Once subscribed you can view requests immediately, so if you view even one, no refund is given even on the same day — viewed contacts cannot be taken back.
sub.testPay: Until payment keys are set, it runs as a test payment (no money moves). Once keys are set, the Toss payment window opens.
sub.extraRow: {n, plural, one {{n} extra referral code} other {{n} extra referral codes}}

subPay.title: Confirm subscription payment
subPay.sub: Your subscription starts once the payment provider approves the payment.
subPay.bad: The payment information is invalid. Please check again in Subscription · Referral codes.

subUp.title: Limits
subUp.sub: A subscription keeps you visible in the market. When you use up this month's limit, it resets next month or you can upgrade now.
subUp.cancelB: Canceled referral codes also count toward usage.
subUp.cancelText: Canceling does not restore that month's limit — please double-check before issuing.
subUp.ruleNote: If you are on a paid plan, a plan change applies from the next billing date (no charge now). A first paid subscription starts today. Extra referral codes are a flat {price} each, regardless of the deal amount.

pay.title: Payment methods
pay.sub: Your monthly subscription is charged automatically to the method registered here. Card numbers are not stored on SogaeBank servers — the payment window receives them directly and returns only a token.
pay.assumedB: Payments are not live yet, so no real charges occur.
pay.assumedText: Registering a card will not charge it — you will need to register again after the payment provider review.
pay.noCardSub: The charge will fail on the renewal date, and your subscription expires if you do not register within {period}.
pay.noCardFree: Register a payment method to pay for subscriptions and lead fees.
pay.noStoreB: We do not store card numbers.
pay.noStoreText: The payment window receives card details directly, and SogaeBank keeps only a billing token (billing key). Only the card issuer and last 4 digits are shown. Billing happens once a month; if it fails you are notified and it retries up to 10 times a day.
pay.extraRow: {n, plural, one {{n} extra referral code} other {{n} extra referral codes}}
pay.removeNote: Removing the payment method makes the next renewal fail. To cancel, use Cancel subscription instead of removing the payment method — you can keep using the period already paid.

ntf.title: Notifications
ntf.sub: Notifications about payments and referral progress. Notices involving money cannot be turned off — missing them could cost you.
ntf.empty: No notifications. Deal · settlement · review updates will appear here.
ntf.emailB: Email delivery is not ready yet.
ntf.emailText: Emails sent before domain authentication (SPF·DKIM) is complete land in spam. They would be logged as sent while users never get them — so only in-app notifications go out for now.

likes.title: Saved
likes.sub: Products · services you saved. Request a contract after agreeing on terms in a 1:1 chat — the referral code is issued the moment the chat starts (INV-2).
likes.note: You cannot request a contract right away. The referral code is issued and the referral is credited the moment a 1:1 chat begins (INV-2). If you skip the chat, there is no way to prove who the referrer is, so the referrer cannot receive the referral fee.

events.title: My event entries
events.sub: Events you joined and their reward status.
events.subWaiting: Events you joined and their reward status. {n, plural, one {{n} entry} other {{n} entries}} are being checked.
events.empty: You have not joined any events.
events.noteB: Joining does not mean you receive the reward right away.
events.noteText: It is given after our team checks it, and you will be notified once it is given.

reports.title: My reports

reports.subOpen: {n, plural, one {{n} report} other {{n} reports}} are being reviewed. You will be notified when they are handled.
reports.empty: You have not reported anything yet. If you see a problematic post, use its “Report” button.
reports.noteB: Dismissed reports also come with a reason.
reports.noteText: Knowing why helps you report accurately next time.

inq.sub: 1:1 chats stay on the platform — contact details are hidden if typed. Once you agree on terms, open a deal with “Request contract” in the chat.
inq.filtered: Showing inquiries for one listing only.

lst.sub: See status and performance together. Rejected items show the reason and an edit guide.
lst.forbiddenText: After identity verification, you can see your listings' status and rejection reasons here.
lst.fixDefault: Fix the issue and resubmit for another review.

deals.sub: Your referrals and the referral codes credited to them. Referral credit lasts 90 days from first contact; for referral requests it counts from acceptance (INV-2 exception).
deals.empty: No deals in progress. Deal numbers and referral codes appear here once a referral starts.
deals.myConfirmed: You confirmed · waiting for the other party

fulfills.title: Confirm fulfillment
fulfills.sub: Reports from the business handling your consultation that the work is done. Confirming records it as a closed deal; if something is different, you can raise an objection.
fulfills.noteB: SogaeBank is not a party to this deal.
fulfills.noteText: Fulfillment confirmations are used for the business's performance record; payment is exchanged directly between the parties.

biz.title: Switch to business
biz.sub: Individual members can do everything with identity verification. Get business verification only when you want to receive referral fees as a business (tax invoice).

can.register: List in all sections · post requests
can.deal: Inquiries · create deals · offer referral fees · contracts
can.partner: Apply for partner onboarding · broker verification · qualification review

after.feeBiz: Receive referral fees as a business (tax invoice)

biz.doneSub: You can receive referral fees as a business (tax invoice).
biz.doneNote: Verified on {date}. Referral fees for deals closed after this time are paid to you as a business (deals closed earlier are not covered retroactively and are paid to you as an individual).
biz.pendingSub: Our team is reviewing your application. You will be notified of the result.
biz.pendingNote: If something is wrong, you can fix it in Edit profile · business info before the review ends.
biz.rejected: Your previous application was rejected — {reason}. Please fix it and apply again.
biz.ntsB: Business verification is checked against the National Tax Service.
biz.ntsText: The registration number and company name must match; suspended or closed businesses cannot be verified.
biz.retroB: The verification time is the reference date for receiving referral fees as a business.
biz.retroText: Business verification does not apply retroactively to deals closed before it — it is better to verify first.
biz.devNote: Referral fees for deals closed before business verification are received as an individual in Settlement, after identity verification and a payout account check.

broker.title: Broker verification
broker.lead: To refer real estate, your office registration number must be verified (Licensed Real Estate Agents Act Art. 9).
broker.lawB: Licensed Real Estate Agents Act Art. 18-2 ③
broker.lawText: — Anyone who is not a licensed broker may not display or advertise brokerage properties. So real estate listings can be published only by verified businesses.
broker.retry: Please fix it and apply again.
broker.assumedB: The Ministry of Land (MOLIT) integration is not live yet, so the check is skipped.
broker.assumedText: We do not verify that the number matches records — it will be checked after integration, and verification is canceled if it does not match.
broker.noAutoB: Even if the check matches, there is no automatic approval.
broker.noAutoText: Identity theft cannot be caught by number matching, so our team reviews it once more.
broker.recheckText: This ensures verification does not stay active after a business closes.

brokerSt.title: Broker verification status
brokerSt.lead: See how far you have come and what is left.
brokerSt.pNotApplied: You have not applied for broker verification yet. Please apply first to refer real estate.
brokerSt.pCanPublish: You can publish real estate listings.
brokerSt.pPending: Our team is reviewing it. It takes 1–2 business days.
brokerSt.pSubmitted: Received. The check and document review will proceed in order.
brokerSt.assumedB: The check was skipped because the MOLIT integration is not live yet.
brokerSt.assumedText: A real check runs after integration, and verification is canceled if it does not match.
brokerSt.expiredG: The period has ended. Please upload a renewed certificate.
brokerSt.noGuarantee: No guarantee registered. Approval is not possible without a guarantee (INV-BR4).
brokerSt.guaranteeHint: There is no public lookup for mutual aid guarantees, so you enter the certificate and we track its expiry date.
brokerSt.recheckHint: Verification lapses after the re-check due date.
brokerSt.lapseText: If MOLIT records show closure · deregistration or the guarantee expires, the daily check suspends verification and your real estate referrals are hidden as well (INV-BR2 · INV-BR4). We re-check every 180 days.
brokerSt.newApplyOff: You cannot apply again while an application is in progress
